features.description: Provides JavaScript evaluation using the Jint engine.

options.description: Maximum wall-clock time a single script evaluation may run before it is aborted; empty disables the timeout. Guards against infinite loops.
options.name: ExecutionTimeout

options.description: Maximum JavaScript array length, including sparse arrays; empty or zero disables the limit.
options.name: MaxArrayLength

options.description: Maximum aggregate UTF-8 size of declared JSON parameter values before JavaScript evaluation.
options.name: MaxInputBytes

options.description: Maximum nesting depth of a declared JSON parameter value before JavaScript evaluation.
options.name: MaxInputDepth

options.description: Maximum aggregate number of JSON values across declared parameters before JavaScript evaluation.
options.name: MaxInputNodes

options.description: Maximum managed memory Jint may allocate during one evaluation; empty or zero disables the limit.
options.name: MaxMemoryBytes

options.description: Maximum call-stack recursion depth for a single script evaluation; empty or zero disables the limit.
options.name: MaxRecursionDepth

options.description: Maximum UTF-8 size of a JavaScript result after canonical JSON conversion.
options.name: MaxResultBytes

options.description: Maximum nesting depth of a JavaScript result after canonical JSON conversion.
options.name: MaxResultDepth

options.description: Maximum number of JSON values in a JavaScript result after canonical JSON conversion.
options.name: MaxResultNodes

options.description: Maximum number of statements a single script evaluation may execute before it is aborted; empty or zero disables the limit.
options.name: MaxStatements
